objective: maximize real note revenue and trust; stop volume-first publishing and consolidate the portfolio around distinctive, reusable outcomes

semanticDuplicatePolicy.hardDuplicate: same reader + same moment + same failure + same artifact => one canonical article only
semanticDuplicatePolicy.nearDuplicate: same problem and largely same implementation => merge into canonical article; retire the weaker page
semanticDuplicatePolicy.evidenceRule: Do not delete only because titles look similar; verify the intended outcome and retained canonical page first.

cadence.paidDefault: 0 until portfolio consolidation; after release, maximum 1 new paid article per week unless first-party evidence supports more
cadence.freeDefault: 0 until portfolio consolidation; after release, publish only when it tests a clear intent or supports a canonical paid asset
cadence.rule: No publication for the sake of calendar consistency.

measurement.currentEvidence: Gmail shows multiple likes/follows but no purchase-notification subject was found in the connected side-business Gmail; this is not proof of zero sales.
measurement.decision: Do not declare winners by article count or likes alone.
